messages:
sarah (sales): hey team — Velux POC is hitting sporadic 429s during a bulk embeddings import. Customer says it spikes after ~120k records. they want a quick root cause and also ask if we can temporarily increase capacity for the demo. cc @devon @mike :eyes:

devon (eng): thanks Sarah. can we get a sample request id and the time range? my first guess is per-route concurrency + burst window exhaustion on the /v1/embeddings route.

sarah (sales): request ids: req_0a1b2c3d (15:42 UTC), req_0f9e8d7c (15:44). happening intermittently across 10 concurrent workers. customer also asked how this will affect billing if we bump limits.

mike (eng-sre): quota-bot just pinged earlier: "Rate cap triggered: tenant=velux-prod route=/v1/embeddings cap_type=per_route_concurrency limit=32 current=47 burst_window=60s" — that aligns w/ 429s. link to the alert: https://internal.redwood/alerts/ALRT-8721 :warning:

quota-bot: Rate cap triggered - tenant velux-prod - per-route cap embeddings-upload exceeded. See /internal/quotas for history.

devon (eng): repro steps I'd run locally: 1) tail the request logs: `curl -sS https://logs.redwood/velux-prod?from=1719872500&to=1719877200 | jq '.[] | select(.status==429) | {id:.id,route:.route,concurrency:.concurrency}'` 2) check metrics: `GET /internal/metrics?tenant=velux-prod&route=/v1/embeddings`

sarah (sales): i can pull logs and share a redacted snippet. Customer worried it's a per-route hard cap and wants to know if we can temporarily raise it for the demo.

tanya (solutions): options: - short term: increase per-route concurrency + burst window for the tenant (fast, safe) - mid term: recommend Dedicated or reserved capacity for sustained throughput (gives SLAs) - immediate workaround: lower client-side concurrency and use batching to reduce parallel tokens. we should offer a one-off demo uplift if legal is OK. :+1:

mike (eng-sre): agree. to bump quickly we can send a temporary policy override: `POST /internal/quotas/override {"tenant":"velux-prod","route":"/v1/embeddings","concurrency_limit":80,"duration_secs":7200}` — I'll prepare the override but need signoff from sales for billing note.

sarah (sales): signoff here — Velux agreed to a chargeable demo increase. please proceed. also they asked "will token accounting double-charge during retries?"

devon (eng): token accounting: we bill per token generated/ingested at the route level. retries that re-send the same input will count again unless the client de-duplicates. recommend the customer add an idempotency token for uploads.

sarah (sales): noted, i'll pass that to Velux.

kevin (security): on the security questionnaire front — Velux submitted the standard controls doc. i can answer SOC2, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration. i need the tenant name + inbound IPs for support access. ETA ~24 hours for initial answers.

sarah (sales): sent Velux the secure link to upload IP allowlist.

mike (eng-sre): quick mitigation checklist for now: 1) apply 2-hour per-route override to 80 concurrent 2) enable token prefix caching for embeddings uploads 3) ask client to drop concurrency to 6 workers while we monitor 4) enable elevated logging for the tenant for 1 hour. I'll post snippets once done. :wrench:

devon (eng): logging snippet for us to search sample 429s: ````
# search example
SELECT timestamp, request_id, route, concurrency, tokens FROM requests
WHERE tenant = 'velux-prod' AND status = 429 AND timestamp >= 1719876000;
````

sarah (sales): perfect. also they asked about pricing if we move to Dedicated: can we give a rough ballpark?

tanya (solutions): ballpark reserved capacity for this scale (peak ~50 concurrent embeddings, sustained during import) is $Xk/mo plus per-token usage. i'll follow up with a proper quote — need expected sustained qps and token/day.

mike (eng-sre): override applied (temp-override-8732). watching metrics — will update in 5m.

quota-bot: Override applied - override_id=temp-override-8732 - tenant=velux-prod - new_limit=80 - expires_in=7200s

sarah (sales): thanks team. i'll tell Velux to resume the import with reduced workers and watch. please share if 429s persist after the override. :pray:
__notes: This file is a synthetic Slack thread for POC rate-limit/quota debugging and presales coordination. Contains realistic short messages, mentions, bot notices, and command snippets. No title field per agents.md.
